listed_sector_signals.signal: Oxygen production is mentioned in the discussion of pure-oxygen aeration; no oxygen-production facility is studied.
listed_sector_signals.quote:
Although oxygen production has an associated energy cost, the increased efficiency
resulting from pure oxygen transfer can reduce the electrical energy consumption of com-
pressors, especially in well-designed systems.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: The audited wastewater treatment line explicitly maintains constant flow through subsequent treatment stages.
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
The flow is then directed by
gravity to the intermediate lift station, where five submersible pump groups are employed
to ensure a constant flow rate during the subsequent treatment stages.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Anaerobic biogas production is discussed as an alternative energy source but considered unsuitable for this plant.
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
The production of biogas, resulting from microbial activity under anaerobic conditions,
typically represents an alternative energy source. However, in this case, the type of biolog-
ical treatment of activated sludge with prolonged aeration produces sludge with a high
level of digestion and consequently with a reduced biogas production potential, making
it unsuitable for use.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: A cross-flow minihydropower plant using the wastewater discharge flow is proposed for further study.
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
As an alternative energy source, the auditors proposed studying
the potential use of the available gravitational energy at the WWTP discharge point into
the watercourse, based on a geometric head of 14 m, an average flow rate of 0.3716 m3/s,
and an estimated useful power output of 36 kW, by constructing a minihydropower plant
(cross-flow type) for self-consumption [25].

one_line: The paper evaluates an ISO 50001/PDCA energy audit of a municipal wastewater treatment plant in northern Portugal, covering pumping, aeration, and sludge handling.
